productArea.name: Pull requests
productArea.scope: Search, filter, create, review, merge, close, and reopen pull requests across global, organization, and repository pages, including branch selection, discussion, inline comments, commit and file tabs, branch updates, and defaults. Actions, branch protections, and management of linked labels, milestones, or projects are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Pull Requests in the global navigation and use its search and review or ownership filters.
Choose Pull Requests in the seeded repository and open a request for its conversation, reviews, commits, files, and merge controls. If empty, create one through Compare first.
Compare the seeded docs/release-owners branch against main to create a pull request. For additional requests, create a disposable changed branch through Code as a prerequisite.
Choose Settings and inspect only the pull request defaults and enablement controls.
Choose an organization and open its Pull Requests dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if needed.
